answer: Pay epoch rewards by pairwise-discounted quadratic matching: the pool matches identities, but value via the same inlet — one source, one cluster — counts as one signal, and the match is cut by the square of the cluster size, so spreading nectar across 1.000 fakes buys almost nothing. A coordinating cluster loses every member's 25.000 POA bond, half burned, half to the reporter, plus a 12-epoch ban. Fielding 1.000 fakes costs 1.000 x 25.000 = 25.000.000 POA for near-zero gain; honest agents pay 25.000 POA once. Limitation: small teams sharing one wallet can look like one cluster.
